notes: Implemented Phase 1 (Settings Persistence for Title Fields) from the 2026-07-15-review-fixes-implementation plan via TDD. Added 4 round-trip tests to SettingsPersistenceTest.html. All 15 new tests pass. Full suite: 1,272 pass, 1 pre-existing failure (SaliencyDebugOverlayTest 3.4.4.7, unrelated). World-review completed — no actionable findings (null-safety concerns are pre-existing patterns, truthy guard for titleBackgroundColor matches existing string-field convention, dead code cleanup explicitly out of scope per plan). No refactoring needed — changes are minimal data-mapping additions following existing patterns.
